Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XII OF 2016
ACT XII OF 2016
PAKISTAN HEALTH RESEARCH
COUNCIL ACT, 2016
An Act to provide for
reconstitution and re-organization of the Pakistan Health Research Council
[Gazette
of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 28th March, 2016]
No.
F. 9 (33)/2015-Legis, dated 25-3-2016.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on 22nd March, 2016:
WHEREAS
it is expedient to reconstitute and reorganize the Pakistan Medical Research
Council with the name of Pakistan Health Research Council by providing
administrative and financial autonomy for its efficient functioning;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
CHAPTER-I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Pakistan
Health Research Council Act, 2016.
(2) It
extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.

Definitions

CHAPTER-I
PRELIMINARY
2. Definitions.---In this Act, unless
there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,
(a) "Aid"
means financial assistance as described in section 16(2)(b);
(b) Board
means the Board of Governors constituted under section 5;
(c) "Chairman"
means the Chairman of the Board;
(d) "Council"
means the Pakistan Health Research Council;
(e) "Donations"
means voluntary gift/charity as defined under section 16(2)(a);
(f) "Endowments"
means a fund as described in section 17;
(g) "Executive Committee" means the
Executive Committee constituted under section 9;
(h) "Executive Director" means the
Executive Director of the Council appointed under section 14;
(i) "Fees" means subscription charges
and any other payments as enumerated in section 16(2)(c);
(j) "Fellowship" means association or
companionship between individuals or organizations;
(k) "Finance and Resource Development
Committee" means the Finance and Resource Development Committee
constituted under section 13;
(l) "Fund"
means the Medical Research Fund established under section 16;
(m) "Grants" means financial aid or
other forms of assistance as explained in section 16(2)(b);
(n) Health" means a state of complete
physical, mental, social and spiritual well being and not merely the absence of
disease or infirmity;
(o) "Health research means a process for
obtaining systematic knowledge that may be applied to improve the health of
individuals and populations;
(p) "prescribed
means prescribed by rules;
(q) "rules
means rules made under this Act;
(r) Scholarship means financial support on the
basis of academic/research related progress: and
(s) Technical Advisory Committee means the
Technical Advisory Committee of the Council constituted by the Board under
section 11.

Establishment of the Council

CHAPTER-II
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE COUNCIL
3. Establishment
of the Council.---(1)
As soon as may be after the commencement of this Act, the existing Pakistan
Medical Research Council shall, by notification in the official Gazette, be
reconstituted and reorganized to be called the Pakistan Health Research
Council.
(2) The Council shall be a body corporate having
perpetual succession and a common seal with powers, subject to the provisions
of the Act, to acquire, hold and dispose of property, both movable and
immovable and shall by the said name sue and be sued.
(3) The
headquarters of the Council shall be at Islamabad.

Functions and powers of the Council

It

CHAPTER-III
FUNCTIONS AND POWERS OF THE COUNCIL
4. Functions
and powers of the Council.---(1)The functions and powers of the Council shall be,
(a) to promote, organize, coordinate, and conduct
scientific research in the fields of health including allopathy, Homeopathy,
Harbal, Unani, iovadic and traditional medicine;
(b) to ensure that health research is relevant to
the problems and issues of health in Pakistan within the framework of national,
legal, socio economic development:
(c) to facilitate development of institutional
capacity for research including training of manpower:
(d) to
organize and facilitate utilization of results of the research;
(e) to advise the Federal and Provincial Governments
and any other relevant body/organization on matters related to
health research.
(f) to
establish, strengthen and expand information resource for support of research;
(g) to sensitize the public through information
dissemination of the findings of health related research through publications,
conferences, seminars, media and meetings;
(h) to
provide financial support for health research through grants and fellowships;
(i) to establish linkages with national and
international research institutions, bodies and organizations as well as
relevant community groups and agencies; and
(j) to develop financial and other resources for
its functions and for the support of research.

Board

6. Functions of the Board.---(1) The functions of
the Board shall be,
(a) to formulate policy on health research;
(b) to review and monitor the performance of the
Council;
(c) subject
to other provisions of this Act, to appoint necessary officers and employees,
against sanctioned posts on such terms and conditions as may be prescribed
under the rules:
Provided that the contract appointments
shall be regulated by the relevant instructions of the Federal Government,
issued from time to time and appointment to the posts with emoluments
equivalent to or higher than those of BS-20 shall be made with prior approval
of the Federal Government;
(d) to approve annual budget; and
(e) to
make recommendation to the Federal Government for appointment of Executive
Director.
(2) In
the discharge of its functions, the Board shall be guided on questions of
policy by the instructions, if any, given to it from time to time by the
Federal Government which shall be the sole judge as to whether a question is a
question of policy.

Meetings of the Board

7. Meetings of the Board.---(1) Meetings of the
Board shall be called by the Chairman or the Board provided that not less than
two meetings shall be held in a year. The meetings shall be presided over by
the Chairman and in his absence by the Minister of State or Advisor of the administrative
ministry or in their absence the Secretary of the administrative ministry.
(2) One-third
of the total membership of the Board shall constitute the quorum. All decisions
shall be taken with majority votes of the members present and in case of a tie
(equality of votes), the person presiding over the meeting shall have the
casting vote.

10. Functions

and regulations made there-under and the general or special directions of the

Council under this Act.
(2) Notwithstanding
the provision contained in subsection (1), the Executive Committee shall,
(i) undertake
regular review and evaluation of the research projects and the program to be
launched and implemented by the Council; and
(ii) execute the administrative, financial and
research activities of the Council.

11. Technical Advisory Committee.--- (1) There shall be a
Technical Advisory Committee which shall consist of eight members including the
Executive Director to be appointed by the Board. The Chairperson of the
Committee shall be appointed by the Board.
(2) The
members of the Committee shall be appointed on the basis of their experience in
health related fields.
(3) The term of membership of the members shall
be three years.
(4) The meetings of the Committee shall be
convened as and when required.

12. Functions of the Technical Advisory Committee.---(1) The functions of
the Technical Advisory Committee shall be:--
(a) to
recommend to the Board through Executive Director Research and development
program and strategic plans of the Council along with budget estimates of these
activities;
(b) to
review outcome of research supported by the Council and to suggest methods for
the utilization of the research by the health and other related sectors;
(c) to render advice and report on any technical
matter referred to it by the Council;
(d) to
identify and recommend to the Board through Executive Director suitable
candidates as fellows, scholars and associates;
(e) to
recommend to the Board appropriate policies for the support of the research
activities undertaken by the Council including policies relating to inter
institutional relationship; and
(f) to
act as a primary medium of communication between the Council and the research
and academic community, informing the Board of issues, problems and research
opportunities and in turn, helping to foster understanding within the research
and academic community of the Council's aims and activities.
(2) The
Committee with the approval of the Board may make regulations to carry out its
functions.

which shall,
(a) make
recommendations to the Board on all financial matters of the Council including
plans for resources development;
(b) propose Council's budget to the Board:
(c) prepare
a report on financial aspects of the Council and submit the same to the Board
through Executive Director; and
(d) monitor
implementation of plans duly approved by the Board for resources development.

experience as may be prescribed, who shall be appointed by the Federal

(2) The terms of office of the Executive Director
shall be five years extendable for another term on the basis of performance.
(3) The Executive Director shall be responsible
to the implementation of the decisions of the Board and who shall also
administer the budget of the Council.

16. Establishment
of Medical Research Fund.---(1) There shall be established a fund to be called the
Medical Research Fund which shall be non-lapsable. All receipts of the Fund
shall initially be credited to the Fund. The amounts for the expenditures
related to the operation of the Council shall be drawn from the Fund as may be
prescribed.
(2) The
Fund shall have the following sources, namely:
(a) donations,
contributions, subscriptions, aid and grants made by the donors;
(b) aids, grants or other form of assistance by
the Federal Government or Provincial Government or any of the Foreign
Government, national and international institutions, organizations
and agencies;
(c) fees, subscriptions, charges and any other
payments for any service rendered, such as training, institutional
consultancies, sale proceeds, royalties on publications, commission and
receipts from any other source; and
(d) income
from any investment and deposits.

17. Endowments.---(1) The Council shall
arrange funds for creating an endowment fund. The Council shall invest this
fund and savings from other sources in any security approved by the Federal
Government to create income to be utilized for funding the Council's program.
The income so received shall be utilized up to a maximum of fifty percent and
the balance fifty percent shall be reinvested to offer protection for the
endowment from complete erosion due to inflation. The distribution of the
income from the endowment for the fiscal year from July 1st to June 30th shall
be based on the value of the total income received up to 31st day of December
of the calendar year preceding the fiscal year.
(2) The
Council shall make rules for endowment fund for the administration, payment procedure,
financial powers and investment of the fund. These rules shall require approval
of the Finance Division after approval by the Controller-General of Accounts.

18. Accounts and audit.---(1) The Head of
Finance Department of the Council, as may be prescribed shall submit annual
financial statements to the Finance and Resource Development Committee which
shall make its recommendation to the Board. These statements shall include the
estimated receipts and expenditure and the sums which are likely to be received
for the coming financial years.
(2) After
the commencement of this Act, the Council shall frame a detailed accounting
procedure for maintaining of its accounts after its approval from the Office of
the Controller-General of Accounts and the Ministry of Finance.
(3) The
fund shall be kept in the personal Ledger Account of the Council with the
National Bank of Pakistan.
(4) The
accounts of the Council shall be audited by the Auditor General of Pakistan on
yearly basis.

Provided that the civil servants
appointed on deputation in the Pakistan Medical Research Council before its
reconstitution and reorganization as Pakistan Health Research Council shall
upon their transfer to the Council continue to be governed by the Civil
Servants Act, 1973 (LXXI of 1973), except those who may opt for absorption in
the employment of the Council in pursuance of subsection (2).
(2) A
civil servant appointed on deputation in the Pakistan Medical Research Council
shall be given right to exercise option for such absorption within a period of
six months of the commencement of this Act.

Indemnity

PAKISTAN HEALTH RESEARCH
COUNCIL ACT, 2016
An Act to provide for
reconstitution and re-organization of the Pakistan Health Research Council
[Gazette
of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 28th March, 2016]
No.
F. 9 (33)/2015-Legis, dated 25-3-2016.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on 22nd March, 2016:
WHEREAS
it is expedient to reconstitute and reorganize the Pakistan Medical Research
Council with the name of Pakistan Health Research Council by providing
administrative and financial autonomy for its efficient functioning;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
CHAPTER-VI
MISCELLANEOUS
21. Indemnity.---No suit, prosecution or other legal
proceedings shall lie against the Council, any member, officer or staff of the
Council for anything done or intended or purported to be done in good faith
under this Act or the rules made thereunder.
